lines.say: We'll need your PPS number, proof of address, and photo ID.
lines.zh: 我們需要您的 PPS 號碼、地址證明和有照片的證件。

lines.say: Proof of… address? I don't have an address. I need a bank account to rent a flat!
lines.zh: 地址……證明？我沒有地址啊。我要先有銀行帳戶才能租房子！

lines.say: When you arrive in Ireland, you meet a famous circle. The bank wants an address. The landlord wants a bank account.
lines.zh: 剛到愛爾蘭時，你會遇到一個有名的死循環。銀行要地址，房東要銀行帳戶。

lines.say: I went to the bank three times before I knew what to say.
lines.zh: 我跑了三趟銀行，才知道該怎麼講。

board.cta: 銀行開戶與證明文件・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for the bank.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你去銀行用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for the bank.

lines.say: You'll explain your situation, ask what counts as proof, and understand fees and cards.
lines.zh: 說明你的狀況、問清楚什麼文件算數、搞懂手續費和卡片。

scenes.title: Explain yourself
scenes.sub: 說明狀況：我是誰、我要什麼

lines.say: Part one: explain yourself.
lines.zh: 第一段：說明你的狀況。

lines.say: The clerk sees a hundred people a day. Help them understand you in ten seconds.
lines.zh: 行員一天見一百個人。讓他十秒鐘就懂你的狀況。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I've just moved here, and I'd like to open a current account.
scenes.meaning: 我剛搬來，想開一個活期帳戶
scenes.note: current account ＝ 活期帳戶（美國說 checking account）

lines.say: I've just moved here, and I'd like to open a current account.
A current account is the everyday account for your salary and your card. Americans say checking account.
lines.zh: current account 是領薪水、刷卡用的日常帳戶，美國叫 checking account。

lines.say: I've just moved here explains a lot. Now they know which questions to ask.
lines.zh: I've just moved here 一句交代很多，行員就知道該問什麼。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've just moved here, and I'd like to open a current account.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: I'm here on a working holiday visa for a year.
scenes.meaning: 我是持打工度假簽證來的，待一年

lines.say: Then say why you're here and for how long.
lines.zh: 接著說你為什麼在這裡、待多久。

lines.say: I'm here on a working holiday visa for a year.
We say on a visa, not with a visa.
lines.zh: 簽證的介系詞用 on，不用 with。

lines.say: Have your passport and your visa letter ready before you say it.
lines.zh: 說之前，先把護照和簽證信準備好。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'm here on a working holiday visa for a year.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I'm still waiting for my PPS number. Can I apply without it?
scenes.meaning: 我的 PPS 號碼還在等，沒有它可以申請嗎？
scenes.note: PPS number ＝ 愛爾蘭的個人公共服務號碼

lines.say: And if something is missing, ask honestly.
lines.zh: 如果少了什麼，就老實問。

lines.say: I'm still waiting for my PPS number. Can I apply without it?
A PPS number is your personal public service number in Ireland. You need it for work and tax.
lines.zh: PPS number 是愛爾蘭的個人公共服務號碼，工作和報稅都要用。

lines.say: Sometimes the answer is yes. You won't know until you ask.
lines.zh: 有時候答案是可以。不問就不知道。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm still waiting for my PPS number. Can I apply without it?
Part two: the paperwork.
lines.zh: 第二段：證明文件。

lines.say: This is where most people get stuck. So ask clever questions.
lines.zh: 大部分的人都卡在這裡，所以要問聰明的問題。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: What counts as proof of address?
scenes.meaning: 什麼東西可以當作地址證明？
scenes.note: count as ＝ 算作、被認可為

lines.say: What counts as proof of address?
Count as means be accepted as.
lines.zh: count as 是被接受、被認可為。

lines.say: Don't ask: do you need proof of address? They do. Ask what they'll accept.
lines.zh: 不要問「需要地址證明嗎」，一定要的。要問他們接受什麼。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What counts as proof of address?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Would a letter from my employer be enough?

lines.say: Then offer an alternative.
lines.zh: 接著提出替代方案。

lines.say: Would a letter from my employer be enough?
A letter from your employer with your address on it is often accepted.
lines.zh: 雇主開的、上面有你地址的信，常常是可以的。

lines.say: Be enough means: is that all you need?
lines.zh: be enough 是：這樣就夠了嗎？

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Would a letter from my employer be enough?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Does it need to be the original, or is a copy OK?
scenes.meaning: 需要正本，還是影本就可以？
scenes.note: original ＝ 正本　copy ＝ 影本

lines.say: And always ask this one. It saves a second trip.
lines.zh: 這一句一定要問，可以省下一趟。

lines.say: Does it need to be the original, or is a copy OK?
The original is the real paper. A copy is a photocopy or a printout.
lines.zh: original 是正本，copy 是影本或印出來的。

lines.say: Many banks also accept a document on your phone. Ask that too.
lines.zh: 很多銀行也接受手機上的電子文件，這個也可以問。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Does it need to be the original, or is a copy OK?
Let's see how this goes now.
lines.zh: 來看看這次會怎樣。

lines.say: I've just moved here, and I'd like to open a current account.
lines.zh: 我剛搬來，想開一個活期帳戶。

lines.say: Sure. Do you have proof of address?
lines.zh: 好的，您有地址證明嗎？

lines.say: What counts as proof of address? I'm staying in a hostel at the moment.
lines.zh: 什麼東西可以當作地址證明？我目前住在青年旅館。

lines.say: A letter from the hostel, or from your employer.
lines.zh: 青年旅館或雇主開的信都可以。

lines.say: Great. Does it need to be the original, or is a copy OK?
lines.zh: 太好了。需要正本，還是影本就可以？

lines.say: A copy is fine.
lines.zh: 影本就可以。

lines.say: One visit, not three.
lines.zh: 跑一趟就好，不用三趟。

scenes.title: Fees and cards
scenes.sub: 手續費和卡片：問清楚再簽

lines.say: Part three: fees and cards.
lines.zh: 第三段：手續費和卡片。

lines.say: Banks are polite. Their fees are less polite.
lines.zh: 銀行很有禮貌，他們的手續費就沒那麼有禮貌了。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Are there any monthly fees on this account?
scenes.meaning: 這個帳戶每個月有手續費嗎？

lines.say: Are there any monthly fees on this account?
Monthly fees are charges you pay every month just to have the account.
lines.zh: monthly fee 是每個月光是有這個帳戶就要付的費用。

lines.say: In Ireland, some accounts are free if you pay in a salary. Ask!
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，有些帳戶只要有薪水轉入就免費。要問！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Are there any monthly fees on this account?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: How long will it take for my card to arrive?
scenes.note: How long will it take for … to ＝ ……要多久

lines.say: Then the card.
lines.zh: 接著問卡片。

lines.say: How long will it take for my card to arrive?
How long will it take for my card to arrive is a long question, but very useful. Say it slowly.
lines.zh: 這句有點長，但非常實用，慢慢說。

lines.say: Until then, ask if you can use the app or Apple Pay.
lines.zh: 卡片寄到之前，可以問能不能先用 app 或手機支付。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: How long will it take for my card to arrive?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Could you explain what this charge is for?
scenes.meaning: 可以解釋一下這筆費用是什麼嗎？

lines.say: And later, when a strange charge appears on your statement, use this.
lines.zh: 之後帳單上出現奇怪的扣款時，就用這一句。

lines.say: Could you explain what this charge is for?
A charge is money the bank took from you. What it's for means why.
lines.zh: charge 是銀行扣你的錢，what it's for 是為什麼扣。

lines.say: It doesn't accuse anyone. It just asks. Often they'll remove it.
lines.zh: 這句沒有指責誰，只是問。很多時候他們會直接取消。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you explain what this charge is for?
Part four: when something goes wrong.
lines.zh: 第四段：出狀況的時候。

lines.say: Card lost, money missing, account frozen. Three things you'll want to fix fast.
lines.zh: 卡片掉了、錢不見了、帳戶被凍結。這三件事都要快點處理。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I think my card's been blocked. It was declined twice today.
scenes.meaning: 我的卡好像被鎖了，今天被拒絕兩次
scenes.note: be blocked ＝ 被鎖　declined ＝ 被拒絕

lines.say: I think my card's been blocked. It was declined twice today.
Blocked means stopped by the bank. Declined means the payment didn't go through.
lines.zh: blocked 是被銀行鎖住，declined 是付款沒成功。

lines.say: Banks block cards when you suddenly spend in a new country. Very common for us!
lines.zh: 在新的國家突然刷卡，銀行常常會鎖卡。我們這種人很常遇到！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I think my card's been blocked. It was declined twice today.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I sent a transfer on Monday, and it still hasn't gone through.
scenes.meaning: 我星期一轉了一筆帳，到現在還沒到

lines.say: Next, a missing transfer.
lines.zh: 接著是轉帳沒到。

lines.say: I sent a transfer on Monday, and it still hasn't gone through.
A transfer is money sent from one account to another. Gone through means completed.
lines.zh: transfer 是轉帳，gone through 是完成入帳。

lines.say: Give the day and the amount. It helps them find it fast.
lines.zh: 說出日期和金額，他們會更快找到。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I sent a transfer on Monday, and it still hasn't gone through.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Could you put a note on my account that I've reported this?
scenes.meaning: 可以在我的帳戶註記我已經通報過了嗎？
scenes.note: put a note on ＝ 留下註記

lines.say: And finally, protect yourself.
lines.zh: 最後，保護好自己。

lines.say: Could you put a note on my account that I've reported this?
A note on your account means anyone at the bank can see you reported it.
lines.zh: 在帳戶上留註記，任何行員都看得到你通報過了。

lines.say: Next time you call, you won't start from zero.
lines.zh: 下次再打來，就不用從頭開始。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you put a note on my account that I've reported this?
I think my card's been blocked. It was declined twice today.
lines.zh: 我的卡好像被鎖了，今天被拒絕兩次。

lines.say: Let me check. Yes, there was a security block. I've removed it now.
lines.zh: 我查一下。是的，有安全鎖，我已經幫您解除了。

lines.say: Thanks. And are there any monthly fees on this account?
lines.zh: 謝謝。還有，這個帳戶每個月有手續費嗎？

lines.say: No, not while your salary is paid in.
lines.zh: 沒有，只要有薪水轉入就不用。

lines.say: Could you put a note on my account that I've reported this?
lines.zh: 可以在我的帳戶註記我已經通報過了嗎？

lines.say: Done.
lines.zh: 好了。

lines.say: Fixed, explained, and on record.
lines.zh: 問題解決、費用問清楚，還留了紀錄。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：跟錢有關的兩個字

lines.say: One more thing! Two money words you'll hear from Irish friends.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭朋友講到錢時的兩個字。

lines.say: Before payday, you'll hear this a lot.
lines.zh: 發薪日前，你會常聽到這句。

lines.say: I'm broke until Friday.
Broke means you have no money. Not a broken leg!
lines.zh: broke 是沒錢，不是骨折！

lines.say: And when a price is far too high, Irish people say this.
lines.zh: 價錢貴到離譜時，愛爾蘭人會這樣說。

lines.say: That's daylight robbery!
Robbery in the daylight, when everyone can see. Perfect for bank fees.
lines.zh: 光天化日下的搶劫，用來形容銀行手續費剛剛好。

lines.say: That's daylight robbery!
Let's go back to the bank one more time. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們再去一次銀行。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 今天需要什麼服務？

lines.say: I've just moved here, and I'd like to open a current account. I'm here on a working holiday visa for a year.
lines.zh: 我剛搬來，想開一個活期帳戶。我是持打工度假簽證來的，待一年。

lines.say: No problem. We'll need proof of address.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我們需要地址證明。

lines.say: Would a letter from my employer be enough?
lines.zh: 雇主開的信可以嗎？

lines.say: Yes, that's perfect.
lines.zh: 可以，那就很好。

lines.say: Great. How long will it take for my card to arrive?
lines.zh: 太好了。卡片大概多久會寄到？

lines.say: About five working days.
lines.zh: 大約五個工作天。

lines.say: Account open, card on its way. Brilliant!
lines.zh: 帳戶開好、卡片在路上。太棒了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before you go to the bank.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，去銀行前先截圖。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: Now, I'm off to check my statement for daylight robbery. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 我要去檢查帳單有沒有被搶劫了。下一課見，Bye！
